moments.author: Federal Emergency Management Agency
moments.quote: We’ve heard a lot of rumors about today’s EAS test… It lasts 1 minute, and no action is required. No blackouts, no secret emergencies.
moments.why: The post went viral amid widespread conspiracy chatter tying it to tech outages this week.
